title: The browser tab names the project: gh · OWNER/REPO for the install, Graphyard before the identity loads
description: A real browser opens the served dashboard of two distinct configured project identities. Each document title is gh · OWNER/REPO for that install and stays so through navigation (Workers, Work, an item's page, Back) and reload; before the identity loads, and after sign-out, the title is the plain Graphyard fallback, never undefined and never a stale other project.

steps.name: two installs' tab titles through navigation and reload
